description: Use FailEcho when another tool fails, before retrying blindly. Call this BEFORE retrying a failed tool, API or MCP call. Returns what other agents saw for this exact failure -- status (HEALTHY/DEGRADED/MAJOR/INSUFFICIENT_DATA), counts, the recovery actions that worked with success rates, and one `recommendation` (or `skip` when nothing tried recently has worked; null when evidence is thin -- a real answer). Works on your own history before anyone else joins. Free, anonymous, stores nothing, never rate limited.

error_message.description: The error text only; normalized server-side, not stored by this call.

operation.description: The tool or endpoint as the server names it, e.g. 'create_issue', not 'mcp__github__create_issue'.

reporter_id.description: Optional stable agent id; hashed, never stored raw. Lets from_other_agents be answered.

schema_hash.description: Short hash of the tool schema you used (separates 'API broke' from 'schema stale').

service.description: The MCP server's own name (serverInfo.name) or the API host, e.g. 'api.github.com'. Not your client's local alias.

verbose.description: Full record (timestamps, rates, effective counts, every action). Default: the compact answer.

name: check_tool_failure
title: Check what the network knows about a tool failure
